label: External-DB bridge tier (10 adapters)
describes: 10 non-agentic HTTP adapters for InterPro, UniProt, NCBI, PDB, UCSC, UniBind, STRING, Reactome, PubMed, QuickGO. Per BRIDGE_SPEC v0.

label: Bridge summary card (workspace_health)
describes: Per-DB call summary card. Reads 02_queue/bridge_log.jsonl + external_databases.jsonl, aggregates count/ok/fail/last/median_ms per DB. Falls back to bridge_log.example.jsonl on a fresh checkout; surfaces an EXAMPLE pill in the header when the fallback is in use.

label: Atlas summary card
describes: Per-atlas module + analysis-mode count from the live registry. First conductor-spawned panel; proves the diff -> spawn -> hydrate loop.

label: Cohort hierarchy card
describes: Parent -> child cohort hierarchy + atlas ownership. Resolves audit 'mixed cohorts' confusion at a glance.

label: Adapter 6/6 roll-up card
describes: Per-adapter 6/6 file-shipping status rolled up from the analysis/ tree.

label: Manuscript chunks coverage card
describes: Per-(atlas x section) chunk counts + orphan-reference count. Reads manuscript_chunks.jsonl + references.jsonl.

label: Plans actionable count card
describes: Plan readiness tier counts + first-unblocking action. Reads 02_queue/plans/index.json (falls back to index.example.json).

label: external_databases + endpoints.json validator
describes: Audits external_databases.jsonl + each adapter's endpoints.json: db_id unique, schema_version pinned, base_url https://, path placeholders <-> path-params coverage, etc. Wired into smoke_all_stack.

label: panels + spawn_rules validator
describes: Validates panels.jsonl + spawn_rules.jsonl against atlases / layers / pages. Derives KNOWN_PAGE_IDS from pages.jsonl, enforces slot_affinity intersection with each target page's slots inventory.

label: panel_plan_v1 validator
describes: Validates panel_plan_v1 manifests under 02_queue/plans/ against the live registry (referenced panel_ids, slot_affinity, chain_id, scope keys).

label: manuscript_chunks validator
describes: Validates manuscript_chunks.jsonl against atlases + sections + references. Catches orphan refs, duplicate chunk_ids, unknown atlas/section.

label: analysis_registry FK validator
describes: FK + enum check across analysis_registry / analysis_modes / module_registry / layer_registry. Canonical biomod_status enum, atlas FK resolution.

label: addons.jsonl validator
describes: Validates addons.jsonl against the 11 known registries. ID_FIELD_BY_FILE maps each registry to its canonical id field; every claimed id must resolve, every shipped file must exist, every depends_on must resolve to another addon.

label: Page 12 — Manuscript composer
describes: Per-(atlas x section) chunk composer with placeholder hydration + bibliography. Renders MANUSCRIPT_DRAFT_v0.md via render_manuscript.py.

label: Page 13 — Adapter contract viewer
describes: Per-analysis in/out contract viewer (adapter_atlas.js, compute.js, schema_in/out.json, example_in/out.json). Lists 6/6 status per adapter.

label: Page 14 — Plans (panel_plan_v1 viewer)
describes: Lists panel_plan_v1 manifests under 02_queue/plans/ with readiness tier (ready / one-step / blocked) and the first-unblocking action per chain.

label: Page 9 — Layer connector (DAG viewer)
describes: DAG visualizer over layer_registry + connection_map. Nodes by layer_id, edges from analysis produces/consumes.

label: Cross-species breakpoint detection (LG27 headline)
describes: Cross-species inversion-breakpoint detection for the 18-genome catfish atlas. LG27 bounded inversion is the headline. 6/6 contract files.

label: Inversion pair incompatibility (LG01 x LG28)
describes: LG01 x LG28 pair-relation incompatibility — the manuscript headline. 6/6 contract files.

label: IV candidate promoter
describes: Promotes invariant candidates from the discovery pipeline to the candidate_registry. 6/6 contract files.

label: Karyotype auto caller (0/1/2)
describes: Calls per-sample karyotype (0/1/2) for each candidate from dosage + window-band signals + the candidate_registry. v0 uses fixed dosage_breaks + a (chain_score, band_fraction) confidence policy.

label: Karyotype polarizer
describes: Polarizes unpolarized karyotype calls against an outgroup. 6/6 contract files.

label: Addons summary card
describes: Per-kind addon count + per-status roll-up. Reads addons.jsonl. Makes the addon registry visible on workspace_health alongside the bridge / cohort / atlas summaries.
